title: Fear & Greed Index Explained: What Do the Numbers Mean? (Crypto Beginner Guide)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. The Fear and Greed Index turns market mood into one number from zero to one hundred. Here is how to read it. Sources: CoinGecko, KuCoin Learn.

scenes.head: FEAR OR GREED?
scenes.narration: Is the crypto market scared or greedy right now? There is a popular index that tries to answer that with one number.

scenes.head: ONE NUMBER
scenes.narration: The Fear and Greed Index runs from zero to one hundred. Zero means extreme fear. One hundred means extreme greed.

scenes.head: LOW IS FEAR
scenes.narration: Low scores mean investors are nervous. Roughly zero to twenty four is called extreme fear.

scenes.head: HIGH IS GREED
scenes.narration: High scores mean people are excited and chasing prices. Roughly seventy five and up is called extreme greed.

scenes.head: WHAT GOES IN
scenes.narration: It blends several signals, mainly Bitcoin volatility, trading momentum and volume, social media activity, and search trends.

scenes.head: NOT A CRYSTAL BALL
scenes.narration: It measures mood, not the future. It focuses on Bitcoin and cannot predict prices, so never use it as your only guide.
